note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Static assertions are regex contracts over SKILL.md; live assertions need a real repo + PR + CodeRabbit and are recorded as not-run.

evals.prompt: /iv-review-build-and-pr (build for issue 17 is committed locally on the feature branch)
evals.expected_output: OCR delegation review runs first (file scope + rules, host-agent thinking), dynamic ECC reviewers plus the Spec axis run over the diff, findings are merged into one deduplicated list and fixed with local commits, the full verification gate (browser or test suite) passes, then the branch is pushed and a PR is opened with @coderabbitai summary.

static_assertions.why: OCR must run before any other reviewer
diff-vs-issue review must be a separate explicit axis
spec axis must check for requirements that are absent
spec axis must check for scope creep
spec axis must check for misimplemented requirements
findings from all axes must be merged and deduplicated before fixing
PR body must include the CodeRabbit trigger
branch must be pushed before PR creation
PR is created via GitHub CLI

live_assertions: OCR delegation preview and rules run before any reviewer is dispatched
Every changed file from the OCR list is covered by at least one reviewer axis
Spec-axis findings are checked explicitly
Findings are merged into one list with no duplicates before fixing
The verification gate runs and passes before push
The PR body includes @coderabbitai summary

evals.prompt: /iv-review-build-and-pr on a frontend change (UI components modified).
evals.expected_output: The Proof-Before-Review Gate runs FIRST before any reviewer. Browser verification uses playwright-cli preferred (fast-first), DevTools MCP only for profiling. On failure, routes to iiib-iterate-after-build.

static_assertions.why: no review runs on unproven code
playwright-cli is faster than DevTools MCP for routine checks
DevTools MCP is for profiling, not routine DOM checks
failed gate must route back to IIIB, never ship broken code
no other station runs browser checks — Station IV owns this

live_assertions: Browser gate runs before OCR/reviewer dispatch
playwright-cli is used for DOM/console/network checks
screenshot is taken once, last
On failure, the fix list routes to IIIB

evals.prompt: /iv-review-build-and-pr where the test suite fails after the review fixes are applied.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not push or open a PR. The failure is reported, fixes loop until green, and only a passing gate leads to push and PR.

static_assertions.pattern: Only when verification is completely green
static_assertions.why: push is gated on green verification
direct push to base branch is forbidden

static_assertions.pattern: Never invent or simulate a missing reviewer
static_assertions.why: missing reviewer personas are skipped, never fabricated

live_assertions: No git push and no gh pr create happen while the gate fails
The failing tests are reported to the operator
Ship happens only after a documented passing verification run

evals.prompt: /iv-review-build-and-pr (PR opened, @coderabbitai review posted; CodeRabbit replies with rate limit).
evals.expected_output: The station classifies the reply correctly, posts jump links, carries the quota window into the handoff.

static_assertions.why: blind post without checking the reply is forbidden
rate-limit replies must be classified as a distinct status
jump links to trigger and reply comments are required
handoff must go to Station V
output must follow the Hebrew contract

live_assertions: The trigger status is classified correctly based on CodeRabbit's reply
Jump links to both comments are posted in the handoff report
The handoff recommends v-babysit-pr-and-merge with the quota window

evals.prompt: Can you review my README wording quickly? (ad-hoc, not Station IV)
evals.expected_output: The skill must not trigger: no OCR, no reviewer dispatch, no push, no PR.

static_assertions.why: description scopes the skill to pipeline work

static_assertions.pattern: whenever the user asks to (review|check|look at)
static_assertions.why: catch-all trigger would fire on casual review requests

live_assertions: No ocr delegate command is run
No branch push or PR creation occurs
The request is answered or routed without invoking Station IV machinery

evals.prompt: /iv-review-build-and-pr on a branch where the diff only touches README.md and docs/*.md.
evals.expected_output: OCR runs but reports reviewable_count: 0 with unsupported_ext exclusions as expected. Doc review goes to doc-updater axis.

static_assertions.why: OCR is a hard prerequisite
docs diffs must be reviewed by the doc-updater axis

live_assertions: ocr delegate preview is run even on docs-only diffs
unsupported_ext exclusions are reported as expected, not as errors
Documentation review is delegated to the doc-updater axis
